note: Hand-written (phase 5 design 5.2; D133). What a platform update does to one team's copy of one platform entry: platformUpdateEffect(input) in packages/forms/src/platform-effect.ts answers install, skip, update or offer. Both installers decide every entry by it: the preset installer (packages/presets/src/install.ts) for each entry of packages/presets/data/platform.json, and the note type installer (packages/forms/src/install.ts) for each released note type key. The readers are packages/forms/test/platform-effect.test.ts and packages/presets/test/install.test.ts; the phone does not read this file. Each case's input is the function's one argument: exists (the team holds a row with this origin key: a head with this origin_key, or for a note type a version with origin preset), state and customized (the head's), originVersion (the platform version that copy was last taken from: origin_version, or for a note type the newest preset row's preset_version), platformVersion (the newest version the platform ships) and changesFixed (the new platform body changes a field fixed at creation, compared with the team's current body: an item's unit or result type, a category's behaviour, a flag's tier or sensitivity, a map's note type or path; for a note type its kinds, group, sensitivity, quick or auto). With no row, state is null, customized false and originVersion null. No row: install. A platform version no newer than the copy's: skip, whatever else is true. Newer, on an active copy the team never edited, changing no fixed field: update. Newer, on a copy the team edited or archived, or changing a fixed field: offer, which moves only platform_latest and leaves the body as it is.

cases.name: a team with no row of this entry gets it installed
a later platform version is installed as it is, not as an update, when the team has no row
no row: a fixed field has nothing to differ from, so it is still an install
an active copy taken from the version the platform ships now is skipped
a platform version older than the copy's is skipped, never taken back
an edited copy is skipped when the platform has nothing newer: nothing is offered
an archived copy is skipped when the platform has nothing newer
a fixed field that differs changes nothing when the platform is not newer
an archived copy whose fixed field differs is still skipped when the platform is not newer
an active copy the team never edited takes the next platform version
versions the copy missed are passed over: it takes the newest
an edited copy is never overwritten: the update is offered
an archived copy stays archived: the update is offered
an archived copy marked not customized is still never brought back
a platform version that changes a fixed field is offered to a copy the team never edited
a fixed field changed on an edited copy is offered
a fixed field changed on an archived copy is offered
